## UI



```{r ui}

ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("OE Data Shiny Web App"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput("year", "Select Year:", choices = unique(oe_data_shi$Year)),
      selectInput("location", "Select City:", choices = unique(oe_data_shi$Location)),
      selectInput("region2", "Select Comparison Group:", choices = unique(oe_data_shi$Region2), selected = "MENA"),
      radioButtons("section", "Select:", choices = c("GDP per capita (PPP)", "Employment structure"))
    ),
    mainPanel(
      fluidRow(
        column(12, plotOutput("plotOutput"))
      ),
      fluidRow(
        column(12, plotOutput("employmentPlot"))
      ),
      fluidRow(
        column(12, tableOutput("dataTable"))
      )
    )
  )
)


```

## Server


```{r sever, echo=FALSE}

server <- function(input, output) {
  filteredData <- reactive({
    req(input$year, input$location)
    oe_data_shi %>%
      filter(Year == input$year & Location == input$location)
  })
  
  comparisonGroupData <- reactive({
    req(input$region2)
    oe_data_shi %>%
      filter(Region2 == input$region2 & Location != input$location)
  })
  
  output$dataTable <- renderTable({
    if (input$section == "GDP per capita (PPP)") {
      filteredData() %>%
        select(-Public_Services_Emp_Pct, -Industry_Emp_Pct, -Financial_Busines_Serices_Emp_Pct, 
               -Consumer_services_Emp_Pct, -Agriculture_Emp_Pct, -Transport_Information_Communic_Services_Emp_Pct)
      
    } else if (input$section == "Employment structure") {
      filteredData() %>%
        select(-GDP_per_capita_PPP)
    }
  })
  
  output$plotOutput <- renderPlot({
    if (input$section == "GDP per capita (PPP)") {
      ggplot() +
        # Background lines for comparison cities
        geom_line(data = comparisonGroupData(), 
                  aes(x = Year, y = GDP_per_capita_PPP, group = Location), 
                  color = "gray80", 
                  alpha = 0.6) +
        
        # Highlighted line for selected city
        geom_line(data = filteredData(), 
                  aes(x = Year, y = GDP_per_capita_PPP), 
                  color = "red", 
                  size = 1.2) +
        
        # Labels for comparison cities at the end
        geom_text_repel(data = comparisonGroupData() %>% filter(Year == max(oe_data_shi$Year)),
                        aes(x = Year, y = GDP_per_capita_PPP, label = Location),
                        color = "gray40",
                        size = 3,
                        direction = "y",
                        hjust = -0.2,
                        segment.size = 0.3,
                        max.overlaps = 20) +
                       
        # Label for selected city at the end
        geom_text_repel(data = filteredData() %>% filter(Year == max(oe_data_shi$Year)),
                        aes(x = Year, y = GDP_per_capita_PPP, label = Location),
                        color = "red",
                        size = 4,
                        fontface = "bold",
                        direction = "y",
                        hjust = -0.2,
                        segment.size = 0.5) +
                       
        labs(title = "GDP per Capita PPP over Years",
             x = "Year", 
             y = "GDP per Capita PPP") +
        theme_minimal() +
        theme(legend.position = "none")
      
    }
  })
  
  output$employmentPlot <- renderPlot({
    if (input$section == "Employment structure") {
      columns_to_pivot_Emp_Pct <- c("Public_Services_Emp_Pct",
                      "Industry_Emp_Pct",
                      "Financial_Busines_Serices_Emp_Pct",
                      "Consumer_services_Emp_Pct",
                      "Agriculture_Emp_Pct",
                      "Transport_Information_Communic_Services_Emp_Pct")

      pie_data3 <- filteredData() %>%
        pivot_longer(cols = all_of(columns_to_pivot_Emp_Pct), names_to = "Employment_sector", values_to = "Percentage")

      ggplot(pie_data3, aes(x = Location, y = Percentage, fill = Employment_sector)) +
        geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
        scale_fill_manual(values = wes_palette("Zissou1", n = length(unique(pie_data3$Employment_sector)), type = "continuous")) + # Using a continuous palette for colors
        labs(title = "Employment Sector Percentage by Selected Categories",
             x = "Location",
             y = "Percentage") +
        theme_minimal() +
        scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
        geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(Percentage, accuracy = 0.1)),
                  position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5), size = 2)
    }
  })
}

```

```{r deploy}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)

```
